name: What information should I have ready before I ask for a built-in shelving estimate?

mainEntity.name: What information should I have ready before I ask for a built-in shelving estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most useful evidence is clear photos, room measurements, and a basic idea of what you want the shelves to store. If you already have inspiration images, include those too, because style and finish can change the scope a lot. For homes in places like Denver or Parker, photos of the wall, baseboards, outlets, and nearby furniture help reduce surprises.
acceptedAnswer.description: Have room measurements, photos, and a few style examples ready before requesting an estimate.
